path_safety.symlinks: The runtime follows final config/index/shard symlink targets when opening paths, but the pre-report verifier rejects descendant symlinks; ignored basenames are skipped before type inspection and benchmark separately owns marker creation.
path_safety.hardlinks: A hardlink is a regular file and each relative path's current bytes are compared, but inode identity and aliasing are not bound; alias lifetime and post-enumeration mutation are outside this static verifier-coverage scope.
path_safety.non_regular_files: Symlinks and non-directory/non-regular entries fail, but directories are skipped. A root directory ending .safetensors is the first defect.
path_safety.duplicate_or_reassigned_shards: Index shard names are validated local basenames; indexed and discovered shard sets must match, so missing, extra, or reassigned regular shards fail. The defect arises because discovered entries are not type-filtered.
path_safety.path_normalization: Verifier URL standardization and shard basename validation reject lexical slash, backslash, dot, and dot-dot escapes, but do not bind Unicode normalization, case-folding identity, or inode identity.
path_safety.files_created_after_enumeration: Entries created after the verifier snapshot are absent from that snapshot; this deployment-authority/TOCTOU race is excluded by assignment and does not cure the static directory omission.
